title: Turbine
text: 用于增压发动机的涡轮，输入 5 路、输出 4 路；{Turbine type} 指定涡轮类型 Fixed、{Include wastegate} 指定 on、{Calibrate Performance Maps} 使用测量数据校准表 selection、{Corrected mass flow rate table, mdot_corrfx_tbl} 查找表 array、{Efficiency table, eta_turbfx_tb} 查找表 array、{Corrected speed breakpoints, w_corrfx_bpts1} 指定 Fixed geometry、{Pressure ratio breakpoints, Pr_fx_bpts2} 指定 Fixed geometry、{Corrected mass flow rate table, mdot_corrvr_tbl} 查找表 array、{Efficiency table, eta_turbvr_tbl} 查找表 array、{Corrected speed breakpoints, w_corrvr_bpts2} 指定 Variable geometry、{Pressure ratio breakpoints, Pr_vr_bpts2} 指定 Variable geometry、{Rack breakpoints, L_rack_bpts3} 指定 Variable geometry、{Reference temperature, T_ref} 指定温度、{Reference pressure, P_ref} 指定压力、{Wastegate flow area, A_wgopen} 指定面积、{Pressure ratio linearize limit, Plim_wg} 指定面积，m^2、{Ideal gas constant, R} 指定常量、{Specific heat at constant pressure, cp} 指定比热，按实例取值。
